sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P.
Counsel for Revisionist :- Piyush Narain Dubey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt.Advocate
Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
1.
None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.
2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by judgement and order dated 03.02.1996 passed by Sri A.A.Khan, IInd Additional District Judge, Agra.

The learned Judicial Magistrate City II (Economic Offence), Agra vide judgement and order dated 28.01.1989 passed in Case No. 1882 of 1986, convicting revisionist under Section 7/16 of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentencing to undergo one year rigorous imprisonment with fine of Rs.
2000/- and in case of non payment of fine, he shall further suffer four months simple imprisonment.

Thereagainst, accused preferred Criminal Appeal No. 21 of 1990 which has been rejected by Appellate Court vide impugned judgement and order dated 03.02.1996 and confirming the sentence awarded by Court below.
Being aggrieved, appellant preferred present revision.
